name: Cervantes junction · raised garden door and private patio

eastPlanter.trust: Photos show a low white rounded-corner planter with a clipped shrub directly east of the upper treads, its front set back from the bottom step, which wraps round its corner. Front set back about .24 m (IMG_2196 and IMG_2287 base lines read .2-.3 m); height about .45 m, about level with the threshold; its east end is stopped at the start of the separate low lane-edge wall, which this task does not move. Extent and height are estimates.

trust: IMG_2196, IMG_2287 and IMG_2327 (27 October recheck) show three white risers, not two: the lane, a bottom step about 1.2 m wide with rounded ends, a second step about 1.0 m wide between the west bed's rounded end and the east planter, then a threshold tread in front of the door. Each tread is two rows of small square red quarry tiles, about .3 m. Riser heights read about .18, .14 and .15 m in IMG_2196; they are modelled as three equal .15 m risers to the unchanged .45 m door/patio rise (survey .3-.55 m). The bottom step is flush with the west bed front and wraps the bed's thickened end; the bed now runs to the flight. Door about .72 m by 1.8 m (width/height ratio from IMG_2196) in a white pilaster frame about 1.0 m wide under a curved coping about 1.1 m wide. Garden wall origin, wall line and patio extent are unchanged estimates; tread depths, widths and riser heights are read from photos to about .05 m, not measured; no placement approval.
